verdict.rationale: The evidence shows PayPal exposing its commerce surface to external AI agents: third-party shopping assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini), an MCP server used from the merchant's own MCP clients, and an agent toolkit for developers to build custom agents. None of this is a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to. These items are developer building blocks or integrations with other platforms' assistants, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
